evidence: The recommendation for Option 2 follows directly from the pre-registered decision rule and empirical findings in [M2], where the author's family (anthropic) caught 24/24 planted defects (compared to 18/24 and 12/24 for other families) and showed no self-preference in Part B (0/3 agree and 7.0 mean gaps on its own family's text). Retaining the cross-family minimum requirement is well-supported by the fact that Kimi exhibited self-preference in [M2] (1.0 agree and 0.67 gaps on its own text vs 0.833 and 2.5 on others) and by literature showing that self-preference varies across models and evaluation setups [B5, B6, C2, C4], while diverse model panels reduce intra-model bias [C1].
